confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a July 2026 window from general knowledge of Koh Samui. No live price pages, menus, or listings were checked, and no web sources were used for city prices. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable, though beachfront and local-area prices differ. Accommodation anchors are least certain because rates vary widely by location, room type, and season, and July falls outside the December to February peak. Cocktail and wine are rough estimates cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly double and roughly two and a half times beer), since bar and wine prices are less certain. The FX value came from one search result that surfaced the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect general Thai island-resort price levels, with other Gulf of Thailand and Andaman island destinations such as Koh Phangan and Krabi as reference points and Thai tourist-area food and drink levels as a baseline.
